Anyway, see you later.

who-knows-when...

算起来我已经 9 岁了，

哎呀呀，到了这个年纪，

source:
You ever check out the drum

source:

老师也说过啦，

source:

只要有我帮得上忙的地方，

source:

我现在正在准备点东西，

source:

source:
So, when you're sad, what do
you do to cheer yourself up?
Me, I listen to music.
target:
说起来，难过的时候
你会做什么呢？

source:

Sorry! Heh.
target:
不过嘛，那些详细道理

source:

source:
Music's weird like that.
Why does it hold such power
over our feelings?
target:
音乐真是很不可思议呢〜。
为什么它能那样

source:
Give it some practice and you'll do
fine. I'm sure of it!
target:
多玩几次的话，
我想你会慢慢抓到诀窍的哦。

source:
I'm sure getting into the groove

fun all its own.
target:
同时呢，
你也会越来越享受跟着音乐律动的感觉。

source:
Try not to get all worked up out
there. Make sure to have a good time.
target:
别太较劲啦，
开心玩就好…

source:
Is that so? My bad, then.

这样呀。
还跟你聊了些传闻，
真是失礼啦。

source:
Enjoy the games at your own pace,
alright? See you around.
target:
请继续享受游戏哦。
那回头见。

source:
You've probably heard of something

说起来，这个世界里常听人说的

你知道吗？

the exact point right inbetween each
of your claps.
target:
那每次拍手和拍手之间，
刚好正中间的那个时机，
听说就叫“反拍”。

source:
At least I think so. I'm not so great at

See you around.
target:
嗯，大概就是这么回事啦。
讲得随随便便的，真不好意思哦。
那，下回见。

source:

I've got the jist of it.
target:
不过嘛，我其实也没懂得那么多，
所以讲得可能不太靠谱哦。

source:
So, suppose you're clapping to
the beat of some music, right?
target:
比如说，
你跟着音乐很自然地拍手，对吧。

source:
...Sorry for yelling. I just got a little
excited.
target:
抱歉，刚才声音太大了。
我实在是太替你高兴了…

source:
Good luck on getting those Perfects!
See you around.
target:
Perfect 也要继续加油哦。
那回头见。

source:
By the way, have you ever gotten a
Superb rank on a game?

说起来，你有在游戏里拿过
“高水准”这个评价吗？

source:

收集奖牌之后，

奖励内容，所以要加油收集哦。

source:

right? Sorry if I bored you.
See you around.
target:
如果你本来就知道的话，
那我这番话可就有点无聊啦。
不好意思哦，那下回见。

source:

Try Again, OK, and Superb.
target:
游戏成绩一共有
“再试一次吧”“平凡”“高水准”这三种哦。

source:
And, if you get a Superb,
you also get a medal.
target:
然后呢，只要拿到“高水准”，
就能得到奖牌哦。

source:
By the way, is a sense of rhythm any
different for humans?
target: 说起来呀，节奏感这种东西，对人类来说究竟意味着什么呢。

source:
Maybe I should try some of those
rhythm games myself...
target: 我也来试着玩玩游戏好了…

source:
Well, not like my rhythm couldn't do with

target:
不过像我嘛，
平时倒也不怎么会特意去想这个啦。

improves... that's gotta be

人应该也会稍微开心一点吧。

你最近有做“节奏感测试”吗？

source:

target:
要去数空拍这种事，
还真是挺难的呢〜。

source:
Well, let's take it one step at a time.
See you around.
target:
不过嘛，就慢慢来吧。
那，下回见。

source:

Seems like 65 points is my limit.
target:
我偶尔也会去测，
不过，65 分左右就是我的极限啦……

source:
That second test gives me quite
a bit of trouble.
target:
那个第二项测试呀，
我怎么也做不好呢。

source:
I heard you can hold a conversation
with only rhythm.
target:
说起来，
你知道节奏也能拿来对话吗？

source:
At least that's what a customer
once told me.
Doesn't that sound fun?
target:
前阵子来店里的客人
告诉我这件事时，
我就觉得还挺有意思的，不是吗？

source:
But if you had percussive election
speeches or bongo arguments...
Expect a lot of noise. Hahaha!
target:
不过要是拿鼓来做竞选演说，
或者夫妻俩拿邦戈鼓吵架的话，
感觉会吵得不得了呢。哈哈哈。

source:
You can put words and meanings
behind different rhythms, like morse
code, and talk without speaking.
target:
就是把不同的节奏型
对应成话语和含义，
然后用来交流的样子哦。

source:
Like, bang out a message into one
of those taiko drums, and you could
communicate acres apart.
target:
听说他们会用响亮的鼓声
打出节奏，跟远处的人
交流哦。

source:
We're here in outer space for an exclusive interview
with the spacefaring baseball player, the
Space Batter!

Q. How is this season looking so far?
A. I've been eating rice balls, so it's right on the mark!

Q. What would you say your goal is?
A. To not miss any rice balls!
Q. You have a girlfriend, right?
A. Yes, I do.

Q. What would you say is her best trait?
A. She makes a mean rice ball!

Q. Why do you wear masks in the middle of games?
A. Hm? What do you mean?

Q. Like that rabbit uniform you wore, for instance?
A. I have no idea what you're talking about.

Q. Please answer the question!
A. I'll have to take my leave now. Excuse me.

He's just left his seat!
It seems there's more to this than he's letting on.
That concludes this interstellar interview.
target:
我们现在来采访一下正在宇宙空间活跃中的空中击球手先生！
Q．这个赛季状态怎么样？
A．因为我一直都在吃饭团，状态好极了！
Q．目标是什么？
A．绝不能断了饭团！就是这个。
Q．有女朋友吗？
A．有。
Q．她最拿手的料理是什么？
A．饭团！
Q．为什么在游戏里要戴那种头套呢？
A．你在说什么？
Q．那为什么会穿兔子之类的服装呢？
A．不知道。
Q．请正面回答问题！
A．时间到了，先失陪了。
说完这些，空中击球手先生就离席了。看来其中似乎另有隐情。以上，就是来自宇宙空间的报道。

source:
I own and operate a café.
I guess you could call me the Barista.
Anyway, it's going well, thanks to the regulars.
And, well, just to let you know, I'm a dog.

Many of my customers love listening to music.
A lot of them have especially good rhythm,
and a few have even achieved a full set of Perfects!
I'm always amazed by them!
I may look all professional when I run my café,
but I'll be honest, I'm really putting on a front.

See, it's a little embarrassing, but when I'm off the
clock, I'm always jamming out with these little
dog-sized headphones!

What can I say? I need a little flow wherever I go.
It's complicated. Haha...
I do go out from time to time, so if you happen to
run into me... please pet me!

See you around!
target:
我经营着一家咖啡店。嗯，简单来说，就是这家店的老板。店里的生意嘛，托老顾客们的福，还算过得去。啊，对了，有件事得先说清楚，我是一只狗。
来我们店里的客人，多半都很喜欢音乐呢。尤其是不少人对节奏特别讲究。甚至还有客人完成过好多次“完美挑战”，真是让人吃惊哦！
不过嘛，平时我虽然像这样经营着咖啡店，其实这只是我的伪装。本来的我嘛……说出来怪不好意思的，其实是戴着狗狗专用耳机，到处撒欢的那种！果然啊，少了那股劲头，日子就过不下去呢。真是拿自己没办法。哈哈哈。
我也常常会去各种地方玩，如果你看到我，记得摸摸我哦～！
那，下回见。

解说：节奏是用来划分时间的；节奏感则是通过律动来表现、感受，或自然而然流露出来的东西。

farm.

growing hair!
It was so creepy! I couldn't sell them like that!

I tried plucking the hairs, but I just couldn't get them
all nice and smooth like a vegetable ought to be.
Well, to lighten up the mood, I put on some music.

source:
I'm Tanaka. It's nice to meet you.
So, the other day I found a bizarre scroll in the back of our storage.
Written was the following:

"To you who reads this: you did not come across
this scroll by chance.
I used the powers of ninjutsu to ensure that it would reach you. Do you understand?
Indeed, the writer of this scroll is not only a ninja,
but your ancestor.

The other day, I protected my lord from a storm
of arrows. I risked my life for him.

The night following this daunting task, a dream came
to me. I saw a young man. A discontented young man
with his back against the world.
According to our fortune teller, that young man is you.

Much like me, you risk your life to protect someone.
A young woman.
She too is said to be a descendant of my lord.

I know not if you can comprehend this scroll, but
if so, I ask only that you continue to protect her."

Now, there actually is a woman in my heart.
The other day, I saved her from a slingshot attack.
I put my life on the line for her.

Who knows what could happen next?
My ancestor's ninjutsu might just help in a pinch one day.

“看到这卷轴的你啊。你并不是偶然找到它的。为了让它一定会被你找到，我早已施下了忍术。明白吗？没错，写下这些话的我是一名忍者，同时也是你的祖先。
前些日子，我从箭雨之中保护了我的主人，也就是主公。当然，是拼了命去守护。完成那桩大事的那一夜，我做了一个梦。梦里有个年轻男子。那是个背离世俗、桀骜不驯的年轻人。根据算命婆婆所说，那个年轻人，似乎就是你。而且你也像我一样，为了守护某个人而拼上性命。是个女性。据说，那位女性正是主公的后代。你忽然看到这样的卷轴，可能一时半会儿也没什么真实感，但我还是希望，你能一直守护着那位女性。”
如今，我心里确实有这样一位女性。她就是前些天差点遭人用弹弓瞄准射击，被我拼命救下的那位。虽说我和她今后未必会怎么样，不过这次，我倒想乖乖中一回祖先的忍术……
